subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

By living in a rural area with access to the city, she gets _____.

options.text: to keep an ear to the ground
in for a penny in for a pound

solution:
The correct answer is: **the best of both worlds**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"the best of both worlds"** means to enjoy the advantages of two very different things at the same time. (दोनों दुनिया का सबसे अच्छा)

 
 
• **Example:** By working part-time, she gets the best of both worlds - time with her kids and a career.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that she can benefit from these quite distinct things at the same time because she lives in a rural region with access to the metropolis. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To keep an ear to the ground **(सतर्क रहना): To be well-informed about current trends or happenings.

 
 
• **Example:** She always keeps an ear to the ground to know about the latest fashion trends.
 
 
 
• **On cloud nine **(बहुत खुश): To be extremely happy.
 
 
• **Example:** She was on cloud nine after winning the competition.
 
 
 
• **In for a penny, in for a pound** (एक बार शुरू करने पर पूरी तरह से जुड़ जाना): Once you have started something, you should commit fully to it.
 
 
• **Example:** We’ve already invested so much, might as well go all the way - in for a penny, in for a pound.
